title: Vehicle safety recalls - federal basics
facts: NHTSA oversees federal motor-vehicle safety recalls and provides VIN-based recall lookup tools.

When a manufacturer conducts a safety recall, the recall remedy is generally provided to the vehicle owner without charge under federal recall law, subject to applicable statutory limits and circumstances.
A recall is different from a technical service bulletin, warranty extension or ordinary repair recommendation.
Owners should use the vehicle identification number to check whether a specific vehicle has an unrepaired safety recall.
